title: HandlingEffects
description:
The **entire** interface from damage to handling. Produced by `DamageSim::handling_effects`,
consumed by `VehicleSim::apply_damage_effects`. Arrays are per wheel, ordered FL, FR, RL, RR.
[`HandlingEffects::default`] is the undamaged (neutral) state.

camber_delta.description: Camber change added to static camber, rad.

drag_scale.description: Multiplier on aerodynamic drag (torn panels, open hood).

engine_dead.description: Engine is dead (failed or total loss with `engine_kill_on_total_loss`).

fuel_leak_rate.description: Fuel leak rate as fraction of tank per second; the vehicle cuts the engine when empty.

gearbox_health.description: Gearbox health 0..=1; the vehicle decides which gears are lost below thresholds.

grip_scale.description: Per-wheel grip multiplier (rubbing arches, bent rims).

lights_broken.description: Headlights/taillights broken (cosmetic + visibility to police at night).

overheating.description: Cooling failure severity 0..=1; the vehicle ramps power down over time while > 0.

power_scale.description: Multiplier on engine torque (1 = intact, 0 = dead).

steer_pull.description: Constant steering offset from a bent rack/arms, as fraction of full lock (-1..=1, + = right).

steer_ratio_scale.description: Multiplier on steering ratio responsiveness (1 = intact, <1 = sluggish rack).

tire_puncture.description: Per-wheel tire deflation 0 (inflated) ..= 1 (flat). Spike strips and rim damage.

toe_delta.description: Toe change added to static toe, rad (positive = toe-in).

wheel_lost.description: Per-wheel "wheel is gone" flag; the corner drops onto a hub contact.
